lina: Heads-up from today's bringup: halcyon-4b awq-perchannel int4 shows a spike on persona-chain jailbreaks in the safety suite. Quick paste of the run: :mag:

lina: ```
cmd: ./eval --model halcyon-4b-int4 --qmethod awq-perchannel --calib safety-small --suite persona_chain_v2 --n=6000
run_id: hcy_awq_2024-07-02_0815
summary: refusal_fp16=0.202 refusal_int4=0.145 jailbreak_fp16=0.025 jailbreak_int4=0.061
```

omar: That's a ~2.4x relative increase. Are failures concentrated on long-context (>800 tokens) roleplay chains?
lina: Yes ~80% are multi-turn persona chains or nested role instructions. Single-turn templates unaffected.

peggy: Any tokenization mismatch? awq sometimes changes packing for vocab tails.
jin: Ran a token-diff on 150 failing prompts: tokens identical. Activation diffs show large logit shifts at final feedforward (layers 18-20). KV re-entry points correlate with drift.
sam: Could be scale clipping in AWQ per-channel calibrator. Try re-run with safety-weighted calib set or alternate per-block rescale. Also try stochastic rounding during calibrate.
lina: Proposed actions: 1) jin -> per-layer histograms + top-50 repro ids, 2) sam -> qconfig ablations (stochastic/asym/symmetric), 3) peggy -> expanded persona_chain_v2 -> 20k shuffled run.

infra-bot: canary: halcyon-4b-int4 rollout paused; safety_gate persona_chain_v2 exceeded threshold. Fallback route: halcyon-4b-fp16.

omar: Short-term mitigation: add a post-filter to flag conditional procedural continuations after persona prompts and force a refusal. Low-touch while ablations run.

peggy: I'll prototype the post-filter and run on sample set to measure false-positive tradeoffs. If FP rate is low we can enable on canary routes.
jin: I'll upload stats + 20 minimal repro ids to SAFETY-1765439991-halcyon-awq. Will also test kvcache warm/cold runs to isolate re-entry behavior.
lina: Thanks all. Ping here when ablation runs finish. :thumbsup:
